label: SB-12 TLS handshake rate: full verifying handshakes per second per core
methodology: one server per peer pinned to 1 CPU; per repeat, N worker threads each open TCP + full TLS handshake (verifying client: peer test CA + documented server name, session resumption disabled by fresh contexts) and close; rate = completed/wall, per-core = rate/pinned_cpus. Reports p50/p99 handshake latency alongside the rate (cold-connect component of C7).
tls_material: native: pbrs-grpc/tests/tls_data (localhost); go: grpc-go module testdata CA, foo.test.google.fr; cpp: grpc test_creds CA, foo.test.google.fr. Same provenance as SB-11 peertls; there is no skip-verify path.
unsupported: tonic-pbrs/tonic-prost are unsupported on TLS (rpc-bench tonic transport is plaintext-only per the pure-Rust policy); their cells report unsupported with reason, matching SB-11.
claim_host_requirements: Linux, server pinned to 1 CPU (the per-core figure is rate/1; multi-core scaling stays a follow-up), ephemeral ports >> handshakes_per_rep (connect-side TIME_WAIT churn); the report embeds the live values.
os_limit_policy: port/fd exhaustion during churn marks the cell invalid, never fail; only fail exits nonzero.
